title: Propane Depletion Before Next Refill
dataSources: Victron telemetry (`victron:telemetry`), iOverlander place logs (`ioverlander:place`), Garmin inReach messages (`inreach:message`), and Mopeka propane readings (`mopeka:tank`).
app: Victron Cerbo GX telemetry, iOverlander place exports, Garmin inReach check-ins, and Mopeka propane sensors streamed into Splunk HEC.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=mopeka:tank propane_pct=* burn_rate_pct_per_day=*
| eval days_remaining=round(propane_pct/burn_rate_pct_per_day,1)
| where days_remaining<3
| sort days_remaining
description: Forecasts when each propane tank will empty based on the current level and observed burn rate.
value: A simple depletion forecast prevents cold mornings and surprise stove outages far away from easy refills.
implementation: Calculate a rolling `burn_rate_pct_per_day` from Mopeka readings and alert when fewer than three days remain.
visualization: Table of tanks with current percentage and forecast days remaining.
grandmaExplanation: It counts which propane tank is likely to run dry before you get another refill chance.
